rendersnap.option.fps.tooltip: Shows a small FPS readout over the HUD. Hidden while the debug screen is open.
rendersnap.option.multi_render.tooltip: Uses Minecraft's least urgent chunk rebuild mode while enabled. It can smooth rebuild spikes, but nearby block changes may take a little longer to redraw.
rendersnap.option.zoom_ease.tooltip: Changes how the zoom moves in and out.
rendersnap.option.occlusion.tooltip: Uses Minecraft's section visibility graph to skip terrain hidden behind other terrain. Disable it if chunks vanish or flicker.
rendersnap.option.faces.tooltip: Skips faces between matching full solid blocks. Some resource packs and moving-block mods may need this off.
rendersnap.option.texture_lod.tooltip: Uses rougher sampling for chunk terrain textures. Helps weak GPUs a bit, but far blocks can look sharper or blockier than usual.
rendersnap.option.entities.tooltip: Skips non-player entities when their chunk section is not part of Minecraft's visible terrain set.
rendersnap.option.behind_cam.tooltip: Normal skips far entity and translucent work behind you. High also cuts far terrain sections behind the camera.
rendersnap.option.light_cache.tooltip: Caches distant light reads while chunks build. If far lighting looks stale, turn it off and refresh chunks.
rendersnap.option.fog_occlusion.tooltip: Skips terrain sections past vanilla fog. Heavy fog benefits more, but sky and fog edges can look rough in some areas.
rendersnap.option.fluid.tooltip: Samples nearby light for water and lava during chunk builds. Disable it if fluids look wrong with your pack or shader.
rendersnap.option.weather.tooltip: Stops rain, snow, and weather particles from drawing.
rendersnap.option.sun.tooltip: Stops the sun and sunrise or sunset glow from drawing.
rendersnap.option.fast_launch.tooltip: Gives the world a short grace period after joining before the stronger render cuts kick in. Applies next world load.
rendersnap.toast.reload.title: Refresh chunks
rendersnap.toast.reload.body: Some chunk meshes were already built. Press F3+A if the old look sticks around.
